response.text:
I can’t access quarterly-results.pdf (no file or web tools are available and you didn’t supply the PDF contents), so I cannot summarize it or quote the CEO’s outlook from it.

You can get the summary and the exact CEO quote by one of these options:
- Upload the PDF here (or paste the CEO outlook paragraph and any pages you want summarized). I’ll then summarize the document and quote the CEO with page citations.
- Paste the CEO outlook text (or the relevant pages/paragraphs). I’ll quote it verbatim and provide a concise summary of the rest.
- If you prefer not to upload, tell me the key figures and passages (revenue, EPS, guidance, major events, and the CEO remarks) and I’ll produce a polished summary and include the quoted outlook.

If helpful, here’s a short checklist of the items I need for a high-quality, specific summary:
- Revenue, net income, EPS, and comparable YoY/QoQ changes
- Any guidance or outlook figures (next-quarter or full-year)
- Major drivers (product lines, regions, acquisitions, cost changes)
- One-time items (restructuring, impairments, legal settlements)
- Cash, debt, and margin trends
- Page numbers or the CEO outlook paragraph to quote verbatim

Alternatively, I can produce a generic example of what a quarterly-results summary and a CEO outlook quote typically look like (clearly labeled as hypothetical). Would you like that while you prepare the file or excerpts?
